_comment: CONFIRMED values come from the competition format page (Bay Area, read 2026-11-06). PROVISIONAL values ship with the starter kit at the event (see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md).
name: sequoia-nolimit-2026-bayarea
_blinds_comment: CONFIRMED: start 10/20, +1 level every 20 hands, 250-hand cap (13 levels). PROVISIONAL: every level after the first (blind schedule ships with the starter kit).
_payouts_comment: CONFIRMED default table payouts (format page): 1st 50, 2nd 30, 3rd 20, 4th-8th 0. At the cap survivors split remaining points by ICM.
_tie_comment: CONFIRMED: when several bots bust on one hand, more chips at hand start places higher. Equal start stacks splitting is our assumption.
_rounds_comment: CONFIRMED: 6 scored rounds, weights 1..6, each >= 5,000 iterations, rounds start 20 min apart from build end; each round snapshots the active bot.
